text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
K.S.Miracle claimed victory in the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen. Her dazzling run, 
acknowledged even by her rivals, brought 
smiles to those who supported her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tears of deep emotion welled up in the 
Trainer's eyes as well. A miraculous 
future they had finally reached— and so, 
the story of K.S. Miracle continues.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inspired by K.S.Miracle's racing, Sakura 
Bakushin O declared war on her, aiming to 
become the "Fastest of the Era."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Moving forward, she'd clash with new 
rivals on even grander stages. To build 
momentum, she set her sights on the Yasuda 
Kinen.
